name: Geerling llama.cpp CUDA on rtx2080ti (pi host): llama-2-13b Q4_K_M pp2048+tg128 551.31 tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks). llama.cpp build f9ec8858e (7474), backend CUDA, -fa 1 -mmp 0 -ngl 99 (flash attention on, mmap off). Host: Raspberry Pi CM5 16GB, Pi OS Trixie, PCIe-attached card. Model file size 7.33 GiB, 13.02 B params, Q4_K_M. llama-bench combined pp2048+tg128 figure: one prompt of 2048 tokens followed by 128 generated tokens, reported as a single tok/s. This is neither pure prefill nor pure decode; stored as tps_aggregate with concurrency 1. Whole-system wall power during the run 271.8 W (node scope, not device).
notes: Source issue prints the llama-bench mean and the +/- spread; the stored value is the mean. The Pi-host rows are the same physical GPU on a PCIe-constrained host, so they are not a card ceiling.
